raw_segments.text: Dear Sarah must come into the drawing room and talk to Mrs. Musgrave about India, mimicked
Lavinia, in her most highly flavored imitation of Miss Minchin.
Dear Sarah must speak French to Lady Pitkin.
She didn't learn her French at the seminary, at any rate, and there's nothing so clever
She says herself she didn't learn it at all.
She just picked it up because she always heard her papa speak it.
And, as to her papa, there is nothing so grand in being an Indian officer.
